candidate_relations.reason: Inverse lichen planus is a subtype of lichen planus that affects intertriginous areas like the axilla. The clinical presentation (violaceous, annular patches in the right axilla, pruritus) and biopsy findings (lymphocytes obscuring the dermal-epidermal junction) are characteristic of lichen planus. The localization to the axilla makes 'inverse lichen planus' the most specific diagnosis, and 'Lichen planus, limited to right axilla' is an equivalent description.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: The candidate specifies 'limited to right axilla' which is consistent with inverse lichen planus.
